verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a memory SaaS and open-source framework like Zep and Graphiti, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out control. Data-deletion and RTBF features, audit and API logs, and access controls are adjacent privacy capabilities, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
